column_semantics: The schedule uses one column headed Interest Rate. For floating-rate PIK positions, the printed reference-rate spread is the cash leg when separately shown, and PIK is appended as an additional component, e.g. 3M S + 1.50% + 5.00% PIK. For PIK-only positions, the column prints only the PIK rate, e.g. 15.00% PIK or 12.50% PIK.

rationale: The filing does not present separate Cash and PIK columns, but its single Interest Rate column prints PIK as a distinct additive component when a cash spread is also present: Easy Way is 3M S + 2.50% + 5.00% PIK and Congruex is 3M S + 1.50% + 5.00% PIK. That syntax means the spread before the added PIK is not an all-in coupon; PIK is quoted separately on top. Other schedule rows confirm the same treatment with PIK-only rates such as 15.00% PIK and 12.50% PIK.
